segments.english:
11195—Ramla bint al-Waqi'a³ ibn Haram ibn Ghifar ibn Mulayl⁴—the latter being a diminutive written with two lams.

Khalifa⁵ ibn Khayyat said: “She was the mother of Abu Dharr al-Ghifari.” More than one authority named her, and mention of her is firmly established in—

¹ Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6934.

² Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6935; al-Isti'ab, entry 3392.

³ In manuscript A: “al-Rabi'a.”

⁴ Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6936.

⁵ In manuscript A: “Khalifa.”

segments.arabic: قصة إسلام أبي ذر، ولم تسمّ فيه. وقيل: إنها أم عمرو بن عبسة السلمي أيضا.
segments.english:
[Continuation of entry 11195]

the account of Abu Dharr's conversion to Islam, though she is not named in it. It is also said that she was the mother of Amr ibn Abasa al-Sulami as well.
